g.text: Storage family: Abstract Factory + Memento + Proxy — as built (UML 2.5.1 class diagram)
DAOs + transactions + health that belong together.
MEMENTO: inTransaction() locks, snapshots every store,
restores the snapshot if the work throws.
PROXY: every DAO call holds the same reentrant lock,
so the web server's threads can share the store.
any pair, one target transaction, idempotent.
